summary: The deadlock (CWE-833) arises from inconsistent lock ordering: helperAddBad() acquires BAD_NUMBER1 then BAD_NUMBER2, while helperMultiplyBad() acquires them in the reverse order (BAD_NUMBER2 then BAD_NUMBER1). Under concurrent servlet requests this circular wait can deadlock. The fix makes helperMultiplyBad() acquire the locks in the same consistent order (BAD_NUMBER1 first, then BAD_NUMBER2), matching the good variant, which eliminates the circular wait while preserving the multiply functionality.
